method: Read-only source/report review, HTTP byte comparisons to local dist, and public-city/dist checksum comparisons. No browser/input, hidden state, engine steps, test execution or game modifications.

Use Shift+Tab one step at a time, noting visible focus; prior exact sequence was rescue → Minimap → Pause, but rescue presence changes tab count.
If focus reaches background Pause, Enter once and capture whether both overlays remain.
Restore with visible Resume and actual Close; verify Escape, M and actual Close separately.

nextVisibleProtocol: Complete Dilsukh customer leg by stopping at the visible handover prompt and holding E for at least0.9s.
Capture explicit reward/wallet or delivery-progress change.
Keep foreground and unpaused for at least5.5s: no map, pause, settings, area picker or inactive tab.
Capture actual New order/Accept/Another card, or absence with timestamps. Waiting-for-order HUD alone does not prove a next offer.
Only on a later completed order repeat immediate pause before2.5s, hold pause past the callback, resume and compare. Use Change area → Stay here for recovery if needed.

avoidFalsePositives: Lateness and0heat do not cancel an order; explicit handover can still complete. Simulation timer is paused by map/pause/modal.
Pickup/handover proximity uses direct distance8m, or24m across a divided road when route detour is large. Route HUD distance alone cannot disprove the visible interaction prompt.
Recovery glide ignores driving input until settled; wait for stable landing/camera before judging clearance or heading.
Route distance increases after wrong turns, flight or recovery are not independently proof of broken routing or inaccessible destinations.
PT-007 pending-offer/minimap overlap is already confirmed at594x522: covered-click versus exposed-edge and keyboardM must be assessed separately.
No new street/shop fidelity, full-area completion, continuous driving or browser-console evidence is supplied by this source audit.
